scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,green "tsx watch apps/server/src/index.ts" "vite apps/web --config apps/web/vite.config.ts"
scripts.build: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/game-core packages/bot apps/server && vite build apps/web --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/game-core packages/bot apps/server --pretty false && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --pretty false
scripts.test:e2e: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/game-core packages/bot apps/server && vite build apps/web --config apps/web/vite.config.ts && playwright test
